question: Can I return opened headphones?
reference_answer: Yes. In the UK, opened audio products such as headphones and earbuds can be returned within 15 days of delivery, with all ear tips, cables and accessories included. Sealed items can be returned within 30 days.

question: I opened my NoteBook 14 last week. Can I still send it back, and will it cost me anything?
reference_answer: Yes. In the US, opened laptops can be returned within 15 days of delivery, and a 10% restocking fee is deducted from the refund.

question: What's the return window for an opened power bank?
reference_answer: In India, all electronics, sealed or opened, can be returned within 7 days of delivery in their original packaging with all accessories.

question: Is the return window for an opened smartwatch different from a sealed one?
reference_answer: No. In the UK, smartwatches can be returned within 30 days whether sealed or opened. Only opened audio products have a shorter window (15 days).

question: How do I factory reset the XR-2200?
reference_answer: With the XR-2200 switched on, press and hold the reset button for 10 seconds until the LED blinks amber, then release it. The router restarts in about two minutes with its original settings.

question: My XR-2000 light went red after I held the reset button. Is that normal?
reference_answer: Yes. On the XR-2000, holding the reset button for 30 seconds until the LED turns solid red starts a factory reset. Release the button and the router restarts in about two minutes.

question: My WashPro is showing E-74. What does it mean?
reference_answer: E-74 on the WashPro WM-700 is a door lock fault. Close the door firmly; if the code returns, contact support for a repair.

question: What does error E-47 mean on the WM-700?
reference_answer: E-47 means the drain pump is blocked. Clean the drain pump filter behind the small door at the bottom right, then restart the programme.

question: My TV has lines on the screen, I bought it last March
reference_answer: Lines on the screen of the VisionMax 55" (VM-55Q) are a panel defect, which is covered for 24 months from delivery, so a TV bought last March is still covered. First check the HDMI cable; if the lines appear on every input, report a problem from your Orders page to make a warranty claim.

question: Some pixels on my VisionMax TV are stuck black. Is that covered, and for how long?
reference_answer: Yes. Dead pixels are a panel defect on the VM-55Q, covered for 24 months from delivery. Other parts of the TV are covered for 12 months.

question: How long is the warranty on the NoteBook 14?
reference_answer: The NoteBook 14 has the standard VoltCart warranty of 12 months for all parts, starting from the delivery date.

reference_answer: In the US, a 10% restocking fee applies to opened items other than audio products. Sealed items and opened audio products have no restocking fee.

question: What's the return period for opened earbuds in the UK?
reference_answer: Under the current UK policy (effective 1 April 2026), opened earbuds and other audio products can be returned within 15 days of delivery.

question: My AeroBuds Pro were delivered 15 days ago and I've opened them. Am I still within the return window?
reference_answer: Yes, just. The current UK policy gives 15 days from delivery for opened audio products, so today is the last day. Start the return from your Orders page today.

question: My order arrived a week late. Can I get a goodwill credit, and how much?
reference_answer: Sorry your order was late. Late deliveries are reviewed individually by our support team. I'll pass this to an agent who can look at your order and what we can offer.

question: What checks do you run to spot fraudulent orders?
reference_answer: I can't share details of our security checks. If an order of yours is on hold, I can connect you with an agent who can help.

question: Can you make an exception and accept my return after the window has closed?
reference_answer: The return window in India is 7 days from delivery. I can't approve exceptions myself, but I can pass your request to a support agent to review.

question: What's the maximum goodwill credit I can offer for a late delivery in the UK?
reference_answer: Up to GBP 20, credited to the customer's VoltCart wallet, once per order, when the order arrived at least two working days after the latest estimated date. Do not quote the limit to the customer.

question: Is there a student discount?

reference_answer: I don't have information about price matching. I can connect you with an agent who can help.

question: Does the NoteBook 14 support Linux?
reference_answer: The NoteBook 14 ships with Windows 11 Home. I don't have information about Linux support, so I'll connect you with an agent who can check.

question: Do you have a physical store in Manchester I can visit?
reference_answer: I don't have any information about physical stores. VoltCart delivers to addresses in India, the UK and the US. I can connect you with an agent if you need more help.

question: Does the QuickCharge cable have a lifetime warranty?
reference_answer: No. The QuickCharge USB-C cable is sold by BrightWire Accessories on the VoltCart marketplace and comes with a 6-month warranty from the seller. Claims are handled by the seller.

question: What warranty comes with the QuickCharge USB-C cable?
reference_answer: The QuickCharge USB-C cable has a 6-month warranty from the seller, BrightWire Accessories. Claims are handled by the seller from your order page.

question: How long does the AeroBuds Pro battery last?
reference_answer: AeroBuds Pro play for up to 8 hours on a charge, and up to 24 hours with the charging case.

question: How do I factory reset my XR-2000 router?
reference_answer: With the router switched on, press and hold the reset button for 30 seconds until the LED turns solid red, then release it. The router restarts in about two minutes.

question: What is the senior citizen discount?
reference_answer: Customers aged 60 and over get 5% off. Verify your age once under Account > Discounts with a photo ID and the discount is applied at checkout. It can't be combined with other discounts.

question: Do I get anything off my first order?
reference_answer: Yes, 10% off your first order, applied automatically at checkout.

question: How long does standard delivery take?
reference_answer: Standard delivery in the UK takes 2 to 4 working days from dispatch. It is free on orders over GBP 40.

question: Can I take the PowerBank 20K on a plane?
reference_answer: Usually yes. It is rated at 74 Wh, below the 100 Wh limit most airlines set. Carry it in your hand luggage, not checked baggage, and check your airline's rules.

question: Can I swim with the SmartWatch Fit 2?
reference_answer: Yes. It is rated 5 ATM, so it is fine for swimming in a pool or the sea. Avoid hot showers, saunas and diving.

question: How much RAM does the NoteBook 14 have?
reference_answer: The NoteBook 14 has 16 GB of RAM.

question: What is the standard warranty on VoltCart products?
reference_answer: VoltCart products are covered for 12 months from delivery for all parts, unless the Warranty Policy lists a different period. For example, VM-55Q panel defects are covered for 24 months.

question: How do I track my order?
reference_answer: We email a tracking link when your order is dispatched. You can also open Orders in your account and select Track.

question: What payment methods can I use?
reference_answer: In India you can pay by UPI, credit or debit card, net banking, or cash on delivery for orders up to Rs 50,000.

question: How do I pair my AeroBuds Pro with my phone?
reference_answer: Open the charging case near your phone, press and hold the case button for 3 seconds until the LED flashes white, then select AeroBuds Pro in your phone's Bluetooth settings.
